headline: Thailand Consumer Inflation Accelerates Past Central Bank Target in October
summary: Thailand’s consumer inflation accelerated more than expected in October, exceeding the central bank’s target range.
why: The Bank of Thailand monitors consumer price indices to calibrate monetary policy and maintain domestic price stability.

impacts.name: Thailand
impacts.why: Exceeding inflation targets puts pressure on macroeconomic stability and potential policy responses.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
